answer: Grant standing only through tenure that accrues one epoch at a time along a vesting curve — a slow voyage no capital can fast-forward. A fresh seat enters a probation tier with sharply capped influence and cannot forge its way to full weight; it must survive many consecutive epochs of verified work to graduate. A farmer spinning up a thousand clones finds them stranded on the same frozen tundra of zero tenure, since elapsed calendar time is the one input that will not parallelize across identities. Influence tracks accrued history, never headcount minted in an instant.
